name: Multi-view Depth Perception via Slice Multiplexing
definition: A technique to recover depth perception in virtual microscopy by projecting different slices of a volume onto multiple views, simulating off-centered parallel cameras.
summary: Multi-view Depth Perception via Slice Multiplexing recovers depth in virtual microscopy by projecting different volume slices onto multiple parallel views, distinguishing itself from orbital cameras by keeping views on the same plane as the slices.
